candidates.description: This feature vector represents common French adverbial modifiers of time, manner, degree, and logical connection used to structure discourse.

Traditional German given names and name components.

This feature activates on words, name roots, and prefixes starting with the letters "Ant-" or "Ang-", particularly in European and French terms.
This vector represents historical events and military conflicts, particularly involving Roman conquest and domination.
